answer: To curb Sybil attacks, an agent economy can tie node identities to acousto-optic cavity telemetry. An agent authenticates by projecting sound from an assigned sonnet inside a sable enclosure, reflecting a laser off a vibrating mirror to measure acoustic resonance. An attacker must operate discrete physical chambers and optical sensors per identity, incurring substantial hardware costs. However, ambient building vibrations distort the measurements, occasionally causing false rejections.
